title: Colony PCR Protocol
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7h2hj8e

steps.title: Pick colonies for PCR template
steps.instruction: Select colonies from the plate to serve as template for colony PCR; the number of colonies to pick per plate should be based on the difference between the positive and negative controls.

steps.title: Prepare colony PCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 2×high Taq Master Mix (Enzyme), 5 µL template colony suspension, 0.4 µL forward primer (10 µM), 0.4 µL reverse primer (10 µM), 0.4 µL ddH₂O, and add water to bring the total volume to 10 µL (3.8 µL water).

steps.title: Run test digest and gel analysis
steps.instruction: Perform a test digest of the PCR products and analyze the digested fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis to confirm the presence of the correct construct.

steps.title: Enlarge positive colonies and mini‑prep
steps.instruction: Use the colony PCR results to identify positive clones, expand these colonies, and then perform a miniprep on the positive clones only.
